title: Old Days stuff
description: Changes the hunger system, the bow food system and other things
body:
A plugin that changes the hunger system, stops item stacking, and removes some new features, returning them to the Minecraft alpha-beta version. It works with a resource pack.

All Minecraft food will not stack.

Boats will crash at high speeds when hitting blocks. This can be disabled in the config.
There is also thick fog, which can also be disabled in the config

The alpha resource pack was based on the resource pack: [The Original Work: Alpha Edition](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/theoriginalworkalpha)

The beta resource pack was based on: [Golden days base](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/golden-days)

For best performance it is recommended to play with optifine or

[Continuity
](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity)

[Entity Model Features
](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features)

[Entity Textures Features
](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures)

[Puzzle](https://modrinth.com/mod/puzzle)
